title: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1985
ACT VIII OF 1985
WEST PAKISTAN MATERNITY BENEFIT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance,
1958
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th
July, 1985, and is hereby ,published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6, W. P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958

ACT VIII OF 1985
ACT VIII OF 1985
WEST PAKISTAN MATERNITY BENEFIT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance,
1958
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th
July, 1985, and is hereby ,published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 6, W.
P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958.---In the West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958 (W. P. Ordinance
No. XXXII of 1958), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section
6, -
(a) in subsection (1), for the commas, words, semi-colon, brackets and
figures ", if the newly born child survives her, to the person who under takes
the care of the child ; and, if the child does not survive her, to the person
nominated by her under subsection (1) of section 5, or, if she has made no such
nomination, to her legal representative" the words, brackets, figures and
commas "to the person nominated by her under subsection (1) of section 5
for the benefit of all her legal representatives, or, if she has trade no such
nomination, to all her legal representatives" shall be sub stituted ; and
(b) in subsection (2); for the commas and words ", or, if she has
made no such nomination, to her legal representative" the words and commas
"for the benefit of all her legal representatives, or, if she has made no
such nomination, to all her legal representatives" shall be substituted.

[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th
July, 1985, and is hereby ,published for general information :-
3. Amendment of section 11, W.
P. Ordinance No. XXXII of 1958.-In the said Ordinance, in section 11,-
(a) after the word "woman", occurring for the first time, the
words "or the person nominated by her or any of her legal
representatives" shall be inserted ?
(b) for the words "employer or a woman", occurring for the
second time, the word "applicant" shall be substituted ; and
(c) after the words "such appeal", the commas and words ",
which shall be taken after affording to the applicant an opportunity of being
heard," shall be inserted.
